name: Halo Fit
description: Halo Fit is a modern gym offering strength, cardio, functional training and personal coaching. Start your transformation today.

headline: Train hard.
Rise higher.
hero.sub: Expert coaching, quality equipment and a community that keeps you showing up. Whatever your goal — fat loss, muscle gain or all-round fitness — we'll get you there.

programs.title: Strength Training
programs.body: Build raw power with progressive, coach-designed lifting programs.

programs.title: Cardio & Conditioning
programs.body: Boost stamina and heart health with structured cardio and HIIT.

programs.title: Functional Training
programs.body: Move better in everyday life with mobility, core and athletic drills.

programs.title: Personal Training
programs.body: One-on-one coaching with a plan built around your body and schedule.

programs.title: Weight Loss
programs.body: Training plus nutrition guidance for sustainable fat loss.

programs.title: Yoga & Flexibility
programs.body: Improve balance, recovery and mental clarity.

about.heading: More than a gym — a place to level up
about.body: Halo Fit was built for people who want real, lasting results. Our coaches meet you where you are, build a plan that fits your life, and stay with you every step of the way.

pillars.title: Mission
pillars.body: To give everyone, at every fitness level, the coaching and environment they need to reach their goals.

pillars.title: Vision
pillars.body: To be the community people credit when they talk about changing their lives — physically and mentally.

pillars.title: Philosophy
pillars.body: Consistency over intensity. Sustainable habits beat quick fixes, every time.

whyUs.title: Expert Coaches
whyUs.body: Certified trainers who correct form and keep you progressing.

whyUs.title: Quality Equipment
whyUs.body: Well-maintained strength and cardio machines plus a full free-weight zone.

whyUs.title: Nutrition Guidance
whyUs.body: Practical diet advice that fits Indian meals and your routine.

whyUs.title: Progress Tracking
whyUs.body: Regular check-ins and body measurements so you see the results.

faqs.a: See the timings in the contact section below — we're open 7 days a week.

faqs.q: Do you offer a free trial?
faqs.a: Yes — walk in or message us on WhatsApp to book a free trial session.

faqs.q: I'm a complete beginner. Is that okay?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Every new member gets a fitness assessment and a coach-guided start.
Yes. Personal training can be added to any membership — ask at the front desk for packages.

faqs.q: What should I bring for my first session?
faqs.a: Comfortable workout clothes, indoor shoes, a water bottle and a small towel.
